D01 · Authority

FieldDecision
decisionUse dedicated zone servers for live rules and one authenticated backend for durable state. Client input is a request.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceNo client SaveGame authority; server session caches carry fencing epoch and character revision.

D02 · Native and Blueprint boundary

FieldDecision
decisionC++ owns rule validation, GAS, movement extensions and adapters. Blueprints edit definitions and compose visuals/UI.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceProject custom commands are not built-in Blueprint nodes; read-only runtime access, authority checks even on exposed commands.

D03 · Engine baseline

FieldDecision
decisionTarget Unreal Engine 5.8.3; public release verified, local installation/build not verified.
statuscommitted requirement
consequencePin Build.version/changelist and source build, toolchain and plugin hashes before local acceptance.

D04 · Sprite presentation

FieldDecision
decisionACharacter-based native bodies with Paper2D visual components and a single PaperZD presentation adapter.
statusproposed architecture
consequenceComposition isolates plugin-sensitive code. Confirm the installed Animation Component binding API in Phase 00; no speculative plugin inheritance contract.

D05 · Camera and movement

FieldDecision
decisionFixed azimuth, elevated restrained perspective, zoom only; true X/Y locomotion with Z height.
statusapproved default
consequencePrototype azimuth 45°, elevation 50°, FOV 35°, zoom arm 900–1600 cm; tune in art lab. Orthographic only after comparison.

D06 · Art coverage

FieldDecision
decisionFour-direction fallback and common body until archive inspection; eight directions and missing actions are production tasks.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceNo paid pixels redistributed, no exact source frames guessed, gameplay equipment coverage independent of visual layer coverage.

D07 · Replication

FieldDecision
decisionBegin with generic actor/property/RPC replication.
statusapproved default
consequenceMeasure before replacing with Iris OR Replication Graph; never both. Record compatible installed configuration before optimization.

D08 · Abilities

FieldDecision
decisionChoose GAS; player ASC on PlayerState, enemy ASC on enemy Character.
statusapproved default
consequencePossession/avatar lifecycle bridge and prediction need two-client proof. No skeletal montage dependency and no separate parallel combat stack.

D09 · Persistence stack

FieldDecision
decisionOne ASP.NET Core service on .NET 10 plus PostgreSQL 18, authenticated UE HTTP adapter.
statusproposed architecture
consequenceCompared with TypeScript/Node service: both viable; C# static contracts and long support favor this default. SQL is never accessible to clients.

D10 · Transactions

FieldDecision
decisionOne DB transaction for each economic command, command receipt, affected rows and durable source claim; fence every server write.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceNo DB transaction across an HTTP wait. Persist committed result before replicating success. Cache timeout is unknown, not failure.

D11 · Zone handoff

FieldDecision
decisionClientTravel connects only the transferring player to an independently hosted destination. Backend ticket redemption changes the fencing epoch.
statusproposed architecture
consequenceSource body remains frozen; old authority is invalidated at redemption, not delayed until visual acknowledgement. This closes a dual-writer window.

D12 · Early dependencies

FieldDecision
decisionIntroduce identity/item records, reward receipt and session lock in Phase 05; minimal party/credit contract in Phase 08.
statusdependency adjustment
consequenceFull inventory UI in 09 and full social UX in 19. Phase 08 cannot depend on future item identity or party definitions.

D13 · Resource competition

FieldDecision
decisionExclusive transient action reservation, followed by atomic durable depleted-generation claim and reward.
statusproposed rule
consequenceLosing player receives ResourceBusy or NodeDepleted. Reservations alone never award items.

D14 · Fishing

FieldDecision
decisionServer-owned attempt, bite window and terminal receipt; deterministic client visuals from accepted times.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceMissed/late cosmetic notify cannot authorize catch. Restart cancels unresolved attempts; committed catches survive.

D15 · Crafting

FieldDecision
decisionDeterministic output at first; all material, currency, item and profession changes commit together.
statusapproved default
consequenceNo failure roll initially. Batch limits and per-command output identity prevent duplication.

D16 · Loot and group credit

FieldDecision
decisionInitially party-shared kill credit with equal XP split among eligible nearby members, and personal loot allocations.
statusproposed balance
consequenceRecord contribution/eligibility at defeat; eligible solo outsiders receive no party loot. Named encounter rules may later override.

D17 · Equipment

FieldDecision
decision15 logical positions: Head, Chest, Legs, Hands, Feet, Waist, Shoulders, Cloak, MainHand, OffHand, Neck, Ring1/2, Trinket1/2.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceChest/Top and Legs/Pants are aliases. Stats remain valid when a visual mapping is missing. Two-handed gear excludes OffHand.

D18 · Death

FieldDecision
decisionRetain inventory, XP and quests; safe shrine respawn, remove short harmful effects, reinitialize resources under one recovery policy.
statusproposed rule
consequenceDefault 5% equipped durability loss, no inventory wipe; penalty command is idempotent. Reconnect is not a free respawn/heal.

D19 · Scope stages

FieldDecision
decision24 phases, three slices, six zone-family designs; only two graybox zones required for Slice A.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceNo claim of thousands of players. Guilds/dungeons/trade later committed; PvP, raids, housing, auctions and monetization optional gates.

D20 · Naming and identity

FieldDecision
decisionStable definition IDs, UUIDs for owned nonstackables/characters, integers for quantities and base currency.
statuscommitted requirement
consequenceAuthoring IDs survive renames via migration aliases. No localization strings or asset display names as database identity.

D21 · Narrative

FieldDecision
decisionOriginal world of the Talarin Reach, with river, forest, marsh, highland, mountain and coast regions.
statusnew design proposal
consequenceOriginal working names are not trademark-cleared. Do not reproduce protected fantasy names, maps or dialogue.

D22 · Daily/escort policy

FieldDecision
decisionNo daily resets or escort production in initial core; define extension gates rather than silently enable.
statusscope decision
consequenceRepeatable quests opt in with server cycle IDs; escort needs navigation, disconnect, reset and party-credit proof.

D23 · Publication

FieldDecision
decisionReplace main only after validated documentation generation; retain existing history and a backup reference.
statusexplicit user authorization
consequenceGenerating a ZIP is separate from publication; final report must state actual remote commit or failure.

D24 · Evidence status

FieldDecision
decisionDelivered documentation is an evidence-labeled draft, not an acceptance-complete manual while the archive and installed APIs remain unavailable.
statusevidence constraint
consequenceStatic/browser results are independent of Unreal, database, packaged or multiplayer runtime results.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
